# A structured notes platform where new products go live with no new code


[Prashant Gandhi](https://www.griddynamics.com/author/prashant-gandhi)


[Henry Garner](https://www.griddynamics.com/author/henry-garner)


Structured products evolve faster than the software that prices and books them. At a Tier 1 investment bank, every new product type meant another development cycle. Each cycle stretched into months. The backlog of unlaunched structures kept growing, and the desk could respond only as fast as the engineering queue allowed.


The team built a structured notes management platform where each product is defined as data in JSON Schema. The definition lives outside the codebase. The platform reads it and renders the right pricing, booking, and post-trade screens for that product.


It runs the full life cycle, including products booked on other systems. It adapts its fields and menus to the conventions of each region and trading desk, so every desk works on one platform.


New structured products now go live with no new code. The product team sets the pace and ideas reach the market without waiting in the engineering queue. Pricing, booking, and post-trade all follow the same definition.


If every new payoff still means a new release, this case study shows what changes when the product definition becomes data. Read the full story, then explore how Grid Dynamics approaches[structured products digitalization](https://www.griddynamics.com/blog/structured-products) and[financial services technology](https://www.griddynamics.com/industries/financial-services) for capital markets.
